verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an inference runtime (on-device SDK, the MetalRT/NeuRT engines, and the hosted Wally Cloud), so how it serves prefill and decode is a fair performance axis to ask about. Nothing in the pack mentions separating the prefill and decode phases. The cloud evidence only covers an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and hosted models on RunAnywhere hardware, with no detail on how serving is architected.
